analysis:
Integration review of the operator-model-filter PR. It is mostly docs (changelog, model-autopilot.md invariant 10, model-migration.md, cli-reference.md, troubleshooting.md, configuration.md, protocol-messages.md) plus Swift changes: the operatorModelFilter property and init in ProviderLoop.swift (about head 221-224 and 946-948), the autopilotAllowsModel change in ProviderLoop+AutopilotControl.swift:55, the applyModelSelection/commitModelSelection changes in ProviderLoop+ModelSelection.swift, the alias-successor gating in ProviderLoop+Prefetch.swift (about 353 and 382-388), and test helpers and tests (MockCoordinator.pushPrefetchModel, OperatorModelFilterTests, ProviderModelSwitchTests).

Security effect: without Autopilot consent, the provider refuses coordinator load_model and prefetch_model (model_not_selected) and desired_models convergence, including alias-successor promotion, for models outside the operator's enabled_models selection. This narrows coordinator influence over provider downloads, residency and disk use on TB-002 and strengthens A-004, A-018 and T-016 posture. A nil filter (empty enabled_models) preserves prior behavior. Autopilot-enabled paths keep their own gates and ignore the filter, as documented.

No evidence of new exposure of prompts, keys, attestation, App Attest authorization (TB-011), prefix cache (T-041) or the add-on hold (TB-012). The test helper binds only to loopback in the test target.

Residual unverified items, not findings: (1) the declaration of operatorModelFilter and the operatorFilterAllows implementation are not in the supplied units; (2) the load_model and prefetch_model handlers, which the docs say refuse out-of-filter models, are not visible, and neither is the live-switch path (commitModelSelection rollback: if rollback's applyModelSelection throws, the filter is not restored); (3) the preload and startup paths and the Autopilot download path are not confirmed to honor the filter; (4) the operatorFilterAllows semantics for the union of enabled_models with the start selection are not fully visible. The next reviewer should confirm enforcement on every coordinator-driven load path. No concrete regression is established.
